name: Miro
description: Miro is a visual collaboration platform with an infinite multiplayer canvas where teams do research, planning, and product development from ideation through launch.
best_for: Positioned for product, design/UX, engineering, and product operations teams across industries who want to break down tool silos and align on shared direction.
features: AI workflows integrated with tools like Claude and NotebookLM
Multiple format support: docs, tables, slides, diagrams

alternatives.name: Lucidchart
alternatives.description: An intelligent diagramming platform for visualizing systems, processes, and organizational structures.
alternatives.best_for: Teams focused on structured diagramming over open-ended whiteboarding

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A browser- and desktop-based design tool for interface design, prototyping, and real-time collaboration.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need whiteboarding alongside actual UI design work
